new_concepts.why: DeepWell has one 'invoice' type; people ask separately for bills we owe (AP) vs invoices customers owe us (AR). Needs a direction flag (payable/receivable) so 'what do we owe' and 'who owes us' route correctly.
Outstanding balance on an invoice or account; today only 'cost' (document total) exists, so 'who still owes us' and 'balance' can't be answered from the amount printed as Balance Due.
Amount actually paid/received (partial payments, deposits applied); separate from the document total.
Printed Due Date / Pay By; needed for past due, 'bills due this week'. DeepWell has only service_date.
Net 15/30/45/60, due on receipt, COD, 2/10 net 30, EOM; drives due_date and past due.
PO number printed on invoices, receipts and delivery tickets; used to match bill to purchase order; no field today.
Deposit/down payment/retainer/layaway/special-order deposit taken before completion; ambiguous with bank and security deposits.
Refund/return amount on a return slip or refund receipt; and 'what did we refund' questions.
Credit memo / credit note total (negative); needs to reduce the balance, not add to spend totals.
Tax line on receipts and invoices; questions like 'how much sales tax did we collect/pay'.
Pre-tax subtotal on invoices and receipts; must not be mistaken for the total.
Per-item price on price lists, POS receipts, packing slips; no price field today (cost = document amount).
Quantity on hand, ordered, shipped or received; needed for inventory counts and receiving reports.
Item identifier on price lists, receipts, packing slips, inventory counts (SKU, UPC, item #); different from part_number.
Par level / reorder point / low stock; owners ask 'what's running low'.
Gift card/certificate/store credit as an item with a balance and a liability; 'how many gift cards are outstanding'.
Credit held for a customer (returns, overpayments, credit memos) usable later; distinct from refund.
Consignor/shop percentage split and consignor payout owed; consignment tracking is a common retail question.
Role: person who owns goods the shop sells on commission; payee on consignor statements.
Customer-requested item ordered from a vendor, usually with deposit; status (ordered, arrived, picked up, never picked up).
Cash, check, card, ACH, wire, Venmo, Zelle on receipts and payments; last-4 digits; questions 'who paid by check'.
Check number / ACH or wire reference / authorization code tying a payment to an invoice.

W-9, 1099-NEC, 1099-K, W-2, W-4, I-9, resale/exemption certificates: vendor/contractor onboarding paperwork, checked for presence and expiry, not a bill. Today they fall to 'other'. Never store TIN/SSN values.
Total paid to a contractor/vendor in a calendar year for 1099 reporting ($600 threshold; raised to $2,000 for payments after 2025).
Age buckets current/1-30/31-60/61-90/90+ used in past-due questions.
Bad debt / uncollectible / comped balance; status distinct from paid and void.
Completed jobs with no invoice yet; owners ask 'what haven't we billed'.
Inventory shrinkage/loss/damage adjustments in retail count records.
Margin/markup percentage and what-we-paid vs sell-price questions in retail.
Tip/gratuity line on receipts; excluded from sales totals and expense totals.
Start/end of the period covered by a statement; 'as of' date.
Withheld portion of a construction payment until job completion.
Refundable core/container deposit on returnable parts, kegs, cylinders (auto, HVAC refrigerant).
Customer sales-tax exemption or resale certificate on file; may expire; relevant to whether to charge sales tax.
Question 'what do we owe / who do we owe': vendor-bill balances (AP).
Total spent with or paid to a vendor over a period.
Extra fee lines (convenience, trip, disposal, restocking) that are not goods or tax.
Late-payment fee/finance charge added to a balance.
Cash change handed back at register; not an expense.
Discount/coupon/markdown amount on a receipt or invoice.
Shipping/freight/handling charge line.
What the shop paid for an item (cost of goods).
Status: item held on consignment, owned by consignor.
Retail item sold / slow / dead-stock status and sell-through.
Action: customer returns/exchanges an item.
Action: raise/send an invoice; plus unbilled-work questions.
Action: pay a vendor bill.
Action: record/receive a customer payment.
Expiration/valid-until date on gift cards, quotes, certificates.
